question.name: The Guardians' Disagreement
question.text: Two respected villagers disagree over what it means to protect Isola: guarding its traditions or allowing them to change.

choices.label: Give each side a task to demonstrate its vision.

a1.text: The council agrees that remembrance and change can coexist.

a2.text: The debate grows heated until a child asks why protecting the island should require hurting one another.

a3.text: An elder proposes that both sides collaborate on a lasting record of their history.

b1.text: One group restores an old gathering place; the other builds a new one. Both become beloved.

b2.text: Their efforts compete for supplies, forcing a difficult compromise.

b3.text: The groups unexpectedly exchange ideas and produce a better plan than either had proposed alone.
